Eligibility and Enrollment] — it says nothing about pets.

If a pet insurance benefit exists, it has not been ingested here; you'd need to ask HR/Benefits (benefits@northwindrobotics.com is the contact listed for benefits questions [health_plans § 7. Governance]).
